question: Which party won the Delhi Assembly Election in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __BJP__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• BJP wins Delhi Assembly elections, securing 48 out of 70 seats, ending a 27-year gap in power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• AAP won 22 seats, marking a decline of 10% in vote share; key leaders Arvind Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia lost.
 
• Congress failed to win any seats for the third consecutive time but saw a slight vote share increase.
 
• BJP’s manifesto, 'Viksit Delhi Sankalp Patra', focused on women, youth, farmers, transport, pollution, employment, and subsidies.
 
• Election held on 5 February 2025, with a 60% voter turnout; exit polls predicted BJP’s victory.
 
• BJP won across key constituencies, securing 9 seats in West Delhi, 8 each in North West and East Delhi, and 7 in New Delhi.
 
• This win ends AAP's decade-long rule, reshaping Delhi’s political landscape.
